clayresearch.finding: Safe-Effect recurrence separation is now represented as an executable trace invariant: recurrent retries cannot widen capability without an external authorization receipt.
clayresearch.next_test: Ubuntu H1 recurrence budgets {1,2,4,8} with fixed capability set and compromised/stale intent.

frank.finding: P9 causal observability/replay can be concretized as loop-aware TurnTraceEnvelope identities over state/graph epochs, stage semantic hashes, authority/effect receipts and status snapshot basis.
frank.next_test: Map current frozen FRANK planes and existing baseline receipts into envelope fields without changing architecture semantics.

gwt.finding: Validator separately enforces addressable->delivered->reconstructed->uptake->causal_use->outcome->reentry and requires true-stage receipts.
gwt.next_test: Golden traces with truthful, shuffled, lesioned and rescued re-entry while model output is frozen.

emergenz.finding: Trace stage/intervention identities provide the replay address space needed for stage-orthogonal factorial, lesion/rescue and common-driver controls; no emergence claim follows from trace validity alone.
emergenz.next_test: Bind E-CERT2 measurement receipts to exact intervention ids and state/graph basis epochs.

claycode.finding: TurnTraceEnvelope v1 becomes a concrete BASE representability/lowering fixture for loops, hashes, enums, receipts, interventions and authority non-expansion. This run does not justify a new language primitive by itself.
claycode.next_test: After current parser repair, parse/type/effect/canonicalize/lower a trace-validation fixture and prove model/readout values cannot type-check as EffectPermit/capability.

hyperposition.finding: Envelope preserves semantic/active/coordination/physical topology hashes as separate identities and provides intervention addressability without equating connectivity with causal use.
hyperposition.next_test: Pairwise-vs-n-ary, gain, delay, topology-shuffle and rescue traces under frozen model output.

claygraph.finding: Every material trace binds one dynamic ClayGraph delta hash; memory retrieval/admissibility/consequential-use remain distinct in the differential projection.
claygraph.next_test: Generate actual Run ClayGraph deltas from Reference Harness events and verify exact trace<->graph ancestry.

unifieddb.finding: Trace/state/status objects require transactional identity/indexing and replay queries, but this does not imply physical database consolidation. Large payloads should be content-addressed with canonical refs where measured beneficial.
unifieddb.next_test: Benchmark trace index/query/snapshot consistency and amplification on the existing logical substrate before UDB-stage physical choices.

harness.finding: H-WP-11 now has an executable stdlib-only reference validator/differential oracle with 13/13 self-tests, 1400/1400 targeted mutation detections, 64-level recurrence stress PASS and semantic ID normalization PASS.
harness.next_test: Target-host integration against frozen H1 fixtures after BASE PASS, then deterministic replay plus outside-in fault lane.

shared_ancestry_warning: Agreement with FRANK/GWT/ClayGraph/ClayCode contracts is inherited/shared-ancestry evidence unless a discriminating intervention adds independent evidence.
